NEOV.q1: Both sides inside 10 (loan 0.74, cash 5.84); the one-side carve-out was not needed. Market cap present and sane ($196.6M from RH), so no missing-denominator trap.
NEOV.q2: NeoVolta Inc - battery energy-storage systems for residential, commercial and utility use, domestic manufacturing, Poway CA, 17 employees, founded 2018. Manufacturing electrical equipment is not on the haram list (no alcohol / gambling / bank / tobacco / adult / pork / entertainment line). Interest income 0.71pct of revenue, far under the 5pct binary threshold.
NEOV.blind_spot_checks: Ran all three deliberately. (1) haram_pct interest-only blindness does not bite: battery manufacturing has no hidden alcohol/pork-style revenue category. (2) Sector label CONSISTENT with the business - 'Producer Manufacturing / Electrical Products' matches battery storage, unlike ZSTK (cannabis labelled pharma) and AIIR (tobacco labelled Industrial Conglomerates) on Day 18. (3) pb_ratio +6.43, i.e. POSITIVE book value, and loan_pct 0.74 is non-zero - so the YDES implausible-input signature (loan exactly 0.00 alongside negative book) does not apply.
NEOV.defense_adjacency_considered: Energy storage can be sold into defense/microgrid applications. Even where it is, the AMD principle governs: a general-purpose product sold INTO a defense market is permissible; only PURE defense/aerospace is refused. NeoVolta's described core is residential/commercial/utility storage, i.e. general-purpose. Not a refusal.
NEOV.liquidity_note: avg volume 1.14M/2wk, 1.52M/30d - genuinely liquid for this class, unlike most halal PASSes this campaign. Float 48.9M.

findings.what: EOSEW - 'Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. Warrant' - crossed +18.18% at 3.25 and landed in the candidate pool as an ordinary name. It is neither a fund nor a SPAC, so neither FUND_PAT nor SPAC_PAT dropped it, yet C37 eligibility requires COMMON STOCK. Nothing in the pipeline was checking that.
findings.why_it_matters: Two independent failures, not one. (1) Eligibility: a warrant is not common stock and was never tradeable under the protocol. (2) The ranker would have mis-measured it anyway - a warrant's prev_close, coil and premarket high are derivative of the underlying's tape, so its gain%, coil and 30-bar pressure are not comparable to a common-stock crosser's, and it would have competed for the TOP slot on numbers that mean something different.
findings.fix: Added NONCOMMON_PAT to plan/scan_sweep.py with its own 'noncommon' drop bucket, covering warrants, rights, units, preferreds/depositary shares, debentures and notes. Verified on the 06:31 dump: EOSEW now drops mechanically and the candidate count fell 15 -> 14. Preferreds are included for the same eligibility reason and are additionally fixed-income in substance, which is a live halal question of its own.
findings.why_mechanical: The alternative was to remember to exclude EOSEW by hand on every cycle for the rest of the day. That is precisely the hand-ranking drift the rank command exists to prevent, so the fix belongs in the tool, not in my attention.
